acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins were reduced using dithiothreitol (DTT, final 5 mM, 20 min, 56 °C) and alkylated with iodo-acetamide (IAA, final 15 mM, 20 min, room temperature, in dark).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins were reduced using dithiothreitol (DTT, final 5 mM, 20 min, 56 °C) and alkylated with iodo-acetamide (IAA, final 15 mM, 20 min, room temperature, in dark).

cleavage_agent.evidence: For proteolytic di-gestion samples were incubated with trypsin (SERVA Electrophoresis GmbH, Heidel-berg, Germany) in enzyme-to-protein ratio of 1:50 over night at 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: 25 most intensive ions (charge state +2 - +7) were selected for fragmentation, and the MS/MS fragments were generated by HCD, with a fixed NCE of 31.

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were ionized by ESI and injected into an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermofisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Full MS spectra were acquired in the range from 375 to 1500 m/z with a resolution of 120,000 at 200 m/z (AGC target 250%, maximum injection time 150 ms).
